queries.name: inbox-page-1
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('f-a1-inbox') AND `ThreadCategory`.`inAllMail` != 0  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: inbox-page-2
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('f-a1-inbox') AND `ThreadCategory`.`inAllMail` != 0  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 10)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: inbox-ids
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`id` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('f-a1-inbox') AND `ThreadCategory`.`inAllMail` != 0  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: unified-inbox
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('f-a1-inbox','f-a2-inbox') AND `ThreadCategory`.`inAllMail` != 0  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: sent
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('f-a1-sent','f-a2-sent') AND `ThreadCategory`.`inAllMail` != 0  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageSentTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageSentTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: trash
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('f-a1-trash')  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: two-categories-distinct
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('f-a1-inbox','f-a1-work') AND `ThreadCategory`.`inAllMail` != 0  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: label
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('l-a2-travel') AND `ThreadCategory`.`inAllMail` != 0  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: starred-all-accounts
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread`  WHERE `Thread`.`starred` != 0 AND `Thread`.`inAllMail` != 0  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

queries.name: starred-one-account
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread`  WHERE `Thread`.`starred` != 0 AND `Thread`.`inAllMail` != 0 AND `Thread`.`accountId` = 'a2'  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

queries.name: empty-perspective
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread`  WHERE `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` = -1  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 0

queries.name: unread
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('f-a1-inbox') AND `ThreadCategory`.`unread` != 0  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: unread-recently-read
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` WHERE `id` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `ThreadCategory` WHERE `ThreadCategory`.`value` IN ('f-a1-inbox') AND (`ThreadCategory`.`unread` != 0 OR `ThreadCategory`.`id` in ('t02','t04'))  ORDER BY `ThreadCategory`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: mark-all-read
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` INNER JOIN `ThreadCategory` AS `M7` ON `M7`.`id` = `Thread`.`id` WHERE `M7`.`value` IN ('f-a1-inbox') AND `Thread`.`unread` != 0 AND `Thread`.`inAllMail` != 0  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: permalink-date
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread`  WHERE `Thread`.`subject` = 'Subject 07' AND (`Thread`.`firstMessageTimestamp` < 1700007120 AND `Thread`.`firstMessageTimestamp` > 1700006880)  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 1

queries.name: permalink-last-date
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread`  WHERE `Thread`.`subject` = 'Subject 08' AND ((`Thread`.`lastMessageSentTimestamp` < 1700008620 AND `Thread`.`lastMessageSentTimestamp` > 1700008380) OR (`Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` < 1700008620 AND `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` > 1700008380))  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 1

queries.name: mail-rules-inbox
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` INNER JOIN `ThreadCategory` AS `M37` ON `M37`.`id` = `Thread`.`id` WHERE `Thread`.`accountId` = 'a1' AND `M37`.`value` = 'f-a1-inbox'  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 5

queries.name: mail-rules-inbox-before
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` INNER JOIN `ThreadCategory` AS `M42` ON `M42`.`id` = `Thread`.`id` WHERE `Thread`.`accountId` = 'a1' AND `M42`.`value` = 'f-a1-inbox' AND `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` < 1700012000  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 5

queries.name: search-result-ids
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread`  WHERE `Thread`.`id` in ('t01','t05','t30','missing')  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: thread-by-id
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread`  WHERE `Thread`.`id` = 't03'  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC LIMIT 1

queries.name: thread-findby-id-limit

queries.name: threads-by-ids

queries.name: missing-models

queries.name: thread-count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM `Thread` INNER JOIN `ThreadCategory` AS `M6` ON `M6`.`id` = `Thread`.`id` WHERE `M6`.`value` IN ('f-a1-inbox') AND `Thread`.`unread` != 0

queries.name: snoozed-threads
queries.sql: SELECT `Thread`.`data` FROM `Thread` INNER JOIN `ModelPluginMetadata` AS `M9` ON `M9`.`id` = `Thread`.`id` WHERE `M9`.`value` = 'thread-snooze'  ORDER BY `Thread`.`lastMessageReceivedTimestamp` DESC

queries.name: thread-messages-no-body

queries.name: messages-of-threads

queries.name: latest-not-draft

queries.name: reply-candidates

queries.name: eml-latest

queries.name: message-pending-body

queries.name: message-by-id

queries.name: draft-list
queries.sql: SELECT `Message`.`data`, IFNULL(`MessageBody`.`value`, '!NULLVALUE!') AS `body`  FROM `Message` LEFT OUTER JOIN `MessageBody` ON `MessageBody`.`id` = `Message`.`id` WHERE `Message`.`draft` != 0  ORDER BY `Message`.`date` DESC LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0

queries.name: draft-list-one-account
queries.sql: SELECT `Message`.`data`, IFNULL(`MessageBody`.`value`, '!NULLVALUE!') AS `body`  FROM `Message` LEFT OUTER JOIN `MessageBody` ON `MessageBody`.`id` = `Message`.`id` WHERE `Message`.`draft` != 0 AND `Message`.`accountId` = 'a1'  ORDER BY `Message`.`date` DESC LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0

queries.name: messages-by-ids

queries.name: activity-accounts-dates

queries.name: message-scan

queries.name: event-master
